req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task identified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to ensure errors are handled properly, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change
preconditions: Task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a body containing a different ID.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated.
The response body contains the updated task with ID 1.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={"id": 999, "title": "Updated Title", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["id"] == 1
assert updated_task["title"] == "Updated Title"
assert updated_task["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_update_task_invalid_id
preconditions: Task with ID 999 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with a valid task update body.
expected: The response body contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/999",
    json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert "Task with id 999 not found" in response.json()["detail"]

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary_id
preconditions: Task with ID 20 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/20 with a body containing a different ID.
expected: The task with ID 20 is updated.
The response body contains the updated task with ID 20.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/20",
    json={"id": 21, "title": "Boundary Task Update", "completed": true}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task["id"] == 20
assert updated_task["title"] == "Boundary Task Update"
assert updated_task["completed"] is True
